d: Times Music Spiritual, in association with Lalbaugcha Raja, presents ‘Sukhkarta Dukhharta & Ghalin Lotangan’ from the album ‘Raja Ganpati’, sung by Vishal & Shekhar and set to music by Dipesh Varma. Bringing together two beloved Marathi Ganpati Aartis, this devotional offering celebrates Lord Ganesha, the remover of obstacles and the deity worshipped at the beginning of auspicious occasions. Sukhkarta Dukhharta is one of the most cherished Ganesh Aartis in Maharashtra, while Ghalin Lotangan is traditionally recited as an offering of devotion and surrender during Ganpati puja.
